item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 16/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will reach southern China on Friday and bring cool weather to the region during the weekend and early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Rai will intensify gradually and move across the Philippines today and tomorrow. It is expected to enter the southern part of the South China Sea over the weekend, and turn to a northerly track and weaken gradually, but its movement remains uncertain. The cloud bands associated with Rai will bring rainy weather to the northern part of the South China Sea early to midweek next week.
